export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for DENSO HARYANA PRIVATE LIMITED (B-1/D-4, Ground Floor, Mohan Co-operative Industrial Estate, Mathura Road) shows 166,208 total shipment records, 250 trading partners, 114 ports, latest cargo 2026-02-28. Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | DENSO HARYANA PRIVATE LIMITED | DENSO TEN (THAILAND) LTD | DATA COMMUNICATION MODULE (FOC)- DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | BANGKOK, THAILAND | 85176290 | 1122736" — i.e. an outbound (India -> Bangkok) consignment dated 2026-02-28, HS 85176290, B/L 1122736. Counter check: page header claims 166,208 shipments; only 4 detail rows were visible on the free view (3 of them inbound: Toyotsu Machinery x2 from Tokyo Narita, Rohm Semiconductor from Singapore/Malaysia), so the export direction is confirmed by 1 of 4 visible rows, not by the full claimed volume.
note: Export side is factually supported: at least one dated outbound customs record with destination (Bangkok, Thailand), HS 85176290 and B/L number 1122736, matching the declared HS 851762 family (85176290 is the 8-digit Indian tariff line under 851762). The company is a large DENSO group automotive-component plant (Mohan Co-operative Industrial Estate, Mathura Road, Delhi address; ports Nagoya, Gari Harsaru ICD, Delhi Air Cargo), so the bulk of the 166k records are inbound components from DENSO Corporation Japan, DENSO International Asia Singapore and Toyotsu — the declared HS 851762 is consistent with the one visible export line but the overall trade profile is automotive electronics, not generic IT. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, annual-report India splits) could NOT be retrieved: web_search returned connection errors on every attempt, and thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, tofler.in and volza.com all returned HTTP 403/404. Revenue and domestic turnover are therefore null — not public in the sources reachable here, not estimated. No rejection grounds: the entity is active and shipping as of 2026-02-28.
